purpose: Teach: 滑走/注入/征服/履修/標高/図形/代謝/点滴

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新規市場への滑走路を作れ
lines.en: We need to build a runway into new markets.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Sharp attack on each noun. No breath between clauses. Eyes forward, chin level. A directive, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資本注入の計画を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare a capital investment plan.
lines.style: Steady, measured response. Slight nod in the voice on the opening word. Write it down mentally as you speak. Professional but not stiff — the calm of someone who knows what comes next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の征服を目指せ
lines.en: We're aiming to dominate the industry.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. Emphasis lands on 「dominate」 with quiet intensity. Slower than the first line — let the weight of it settle. This is not casual ambition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修の履修管理を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll tighten our employee development and track every step of it.
lines.style: Nod of commitment in the opening. Methodical enumeration — each action laid out like a checklist. Voice stays even, competent. The sound of someone translating intention into process.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の標高、つまりトップを目指せ
lines.en: The industry benchmark is the top. That's where we're headed.
lines.style: Slight pause before speaking — gathering focus. Measured, deliberate pacing. The word 「top」 lands with quiet conviction. No rush, no doubt. This is the standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織図形の見直しを進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll reorganize the structure to support that.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment with a thread of confidence underneath. Not defensive — this is work that can be done. Voice steady, slightly forward-leaning in posture. The sound of someone already planning the first move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新陳代謝の良い組織を作れ
lines.en: We need an organization with fresh energy — one that renews itself.
lines.style: Soften slightly on 「fresh energy」 — this is not cold structure, it's living change. Measured pace. The voice settles into something almost conversational beneath the directive. This matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の点滴的なケアではなく根本的支援をします
lines.en: Yes. I'll provide real support to our people — not just maintenance, but genuine development.
lines.style: The opening 「Yes」 carries quiet weight — this one landed. Slower delivery on the distinction between the two approaches. Voice warms fractionally on 「genuine development」. The sound of someone who understands what the boss actually meant.
